recap: Cavaliers lost to the Trail Blazers 129–110.
Collin Sexton led the Cavaliers with 25 points (8-16 FG, 1-2 3PT), 3 rebounds and 5 assists.
Gary Trent Jr. led the Trail Blazers with 26 points (8-12 FG, 4-6 3PT), 3 rebounds and 2 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 48.3 to 59.6.
Biggest swing: Darius Garland shooting foul (Q1 10:33), −3 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Windler, Stevens, Sexton, Garland, Okoro, +3 in 4:11.
Bench points: CLE 56, POR 54. Points in the paint: 52–52. Second-chance points: 21–17.
